# Section vertical alignment

Original OOXML controls generated by `tools/page_vertical_alignment_fixture.py`.
They contain no corpus content or artwork. The reference application exported
the references without saving the sources. Arial is required for native text
comparison and is not redistributed.

| Source | native reference PDF | Pages | Coverage |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| control.docx | native.pdf | 29 | Top/center/bottom/both; one paragraph, three paragraphs, manual line breaks, before/after spacing, inline tables, page breaks, final-page justification |
| floating.docx | floating-native.pdf | 8 | All four alignments with text- and page-positioned full-width floating tables |

Run the generator, export both sources with `tools/export-reference.ps1`,
then run `tools/record_page_vertical_alignment.py` and the same command with
`floating`. Reference JSON pins source/PDF hashes and non-whitespace text
origins. Every regenerated floating-source OPC part was compared with the
package used for reference export.

ECMA-376 Part 1 §§17.6.23 and 17.18.101 define page vertical alignment. The
`both` definition says to ignore the setting when the document ends mid-page.
The reference application instead distributes the three paragraphs on the final control page from
baseline 86.42 pt to 716.52 pt. This is a demonstrated compatibility divergence.
Distribution inserts gaps between paragraphs, not between manual lines in one
paragraph. An inline table is one block; its row spacing does not expand.
Before/after paragraph spacing remains part of the occupied height.

Center/bottom positioning occurs after floating-table text wrapping converges.
Page-positioned floating tables also exclude preceding text. Their page-fixed
positions move with center/bottom body alignment; under `both`, they remain
fixed. A text-positioned table moves with its following anchor paragraph.

All 37 page text layouts match the reference application within 0.15 pt vertically. Browser coverage
also checks caret hits, editing, export/reopen and exact undo. These controls
do not establish vertical-alignment behavior with columns or continuous
sections; those combinations remain explicitly unsupported.
